finding.title: Concurrent posts can overwrite each other
finding.description: Post reads the balance, then writes it back without a lock, so two concurrent posts lose one update.
finding.evidence: go test -race ./internal/ledger -run TestConcurrentPost fails 7 of 10 runs.
finding.impact: A posted transaction is silently lost with 50 concurrent users.
finding.blocking_rationale: A pilot with partner books must not lose transactions.
